description: This file defines the React component 'CostTrackingSettings' responsible for managing cost discount configurations within the UI. It includes state management, fetch and update logic for discount configurations, and UI elements like tabs, modals, and forms for interacting with provider discounts.

methods.name: fetchDiscountConfig
methods.description: Fetches the current discount configuration from the backend and updates state.

methods.name: saveDiscountConfig
methods.description: Saves the updated discount configuration to the backend.

methods.name: handleAddProvider
methods.description: Handles adding a new provider discount, including validation and updating state.

methods.name: handleModalCancel
methods.description: Resets modal form state and closes the add provider modal.

methods.name: handleFormSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the add provider form.

methods.name: handleRemoveProvider
methods.description: Confirms and removes a provider discount from the configuration.

methods.name: handleDiscountChange
methods.description: Updates the discount value for a specific provider and saves it.
